story.iWant: to manually trigger a data synchronization
story.soThat: I can refresh my data on-demand without waiting for scheduled sync

tasks.task: Implement real-time progress tracking for manual sync (AC: #1)
Create sync status page or integrate into dashboard (AC: #1, #2)
Integrate manual sync with existing sync infrastructure (AC: #1)
Create TanStack Query hook for manual sync (AC: #1)

criterion.given: I am logged in and viewing my dashboard or sync page
criterion.when: I click "Sync Now" or "Refresh Data" button
criterion.then: - Immediately starts synchronization process - Shows loading state on button (disabled, spinner) - Displays real-time sync progress - Imports all new games since last sync - Updates existing games with latest data from gomafia.pro - Shows completion status with summary (X new games imported, Y games updated)

- Can be triggered even if scheduled sync is configured - Respects concurrent import prevention (see Story 2.8) - Shows clear feedback: "Sync started", "Sync in progress", "Sync completed" - If sync already running, shows message: "Sync already in progress. Please wait."

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR9: Users can manually trigger data import/synchronization. System validates imported data quality with ≥98% accuracy threshold. System handles import errors gracefully with retry mechanisms. Users can view import progress in real-time.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Rate limiting: Enforce 2-second delay between requests (30 requests per minute max) to respect gomafia.pro servers. Use existing RateLimiter class. Error handling: Use existing SkippedEntitiesManager for failed scraping operations. Advisory locks: Use AdvisoryLock class to prevent concurrent imports.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use TanStack Query for server state (sync status polling). Configuration in src/lib/queryClient.ts. Use useMutation for triggering sync, useQuery with polling for progress updates.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use ShadCN/UI components: Button with loading states, Progress for progress bar, Toast for notifications, Card for status display.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: From Design System (ShadCN/UI + Registries): Buttons, forms, inputs, modals, dialogs, Cards, tables, badges, avatars, Navigation components, Chart containers and wrappers, Loading states, skeletons, Toast notifications.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Goal: System can reliably import and synchronize game data from gomafia.pro with quality validation. Scope includes automatic and manual synchronization, real-time import progress tracking, checkpoint/resume capability, concurrent import prevention.

doc.title: Story 2.2: Automatic Scheduled Synchronization
doc.snippet: Incremental Sync Infrastructure: ImportOrchestrator.syncIncremental() method exists and can be reused for manual sync. Concurrent Import Prevention: AdvisoryLock class exists with user-specific locks. Rate Limiting: Existing RateLimiter class enforces 2-second delays. Progress Tracking: CheckpointManager and sync_status table exist for tracking import progress.

artifact.reason: Existing manual sync trigger endpoint that checks for active syncs and prevents concurrent operations. Can be adapted for user-specific manual sync.
Main import orchestration class. Contains syncIncremental() method that can be reused for manual sync. Manages checkpoints, validation, batch processing, progress tracking.

Advisory lock manager for preventing concurrent imports. Has acquireLock(userId?) method that supports user-specific locks, allowing different users to import simultaneously while preventing same-user concurrent imports.
Rate limiter class that enforces 2-second delays (2000ms) between requests to respect gomafia.pro servers. Manual sync must use same rate limiting.
Existing sync status API endpoint that returns current sync progress. Can be reused for progress polling in manual sync UI.
Existing hook for sync status with triggerSync function. Can be adapted or extended for manual sync use case with user-specific sync triggering.
Incremental sync implementation that processes players needing sync. Can be adapted for user-specific manual sync.
ShadCN/UI Button component with loading states support. Use for manual sync button with spinner and disabled states.
ShadCN/UI Progress component for displaying sync progress bar with percentage.
ShadCN/UI Toast component for showing sync completion notifications with summary.
Authentication helper function for API routes. Use to authenticate manual sync requests and get userId.

constraint.description: Follow Clean Architecture + Hexagonal Architecture patterns. API routes in src/app/api/, domain logic in src/lib/gomafia/, components in src/components/
Enforce 2-second delay between requests (30 requests per minute max) to respect gomafia.pro servers. Use existing RateLimiter class.
Use existing AdvisoryLock class to prevent concurrent imports. Check lock before starting manual sync, return 409 Conflict if sync already in progress.
Use existing SkippedEntitiesManager for failed scraping operations. Log errors to sync_logs table. Handle sync failures gracefully with user-friendly error messages.
Use TanStack Query for server state (sync status polling). Use useMutation for triggering sync, useQuery with polling for progress updates.
Use ShadCN/UI components: Button with loading states, Progress for progress bar, Toast for notifications, Card for status display.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text.

Maintain minimum 80% test coverage. TDD approach: Write tests before implementation. Test types: Unit tests for sync logic, integration tests for manual sync flow, E2E tests for user journey, accessibility tests using axe-core.

tests.standards: Test Coverage: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Test Types: Unit tests for sync logic, orchestrator methods; integration tests for manual sync flow; E2E tests for user journey (click sync button → sync starts → progress updates → sync completes → summary displayed); accessibility tests using axe-core. TDD Approach: Write tests before implementation, follow Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Accessibility Testing: Use @axe-core/playwright for E2E accessibility testing, verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
